PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.
ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රිශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රික සමාාජවාාදී ජනරජයේɏ ගැැසට් පත්‍රයක සමාාජවාාදී ජනරජයේɏ ගැැසට් පත්‍රය
අති විශෙˤෂඅති විශෙˤෂThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

RATHNAPURA PRADESHIYA SABHA IT is hereby published for the information of the general public that it has been decided under the General Assembly Decision meeting number 06/01/12 held on 2025.12.09 that the roads and narrow roads stated in the following Schedule are declared as roads and narrow roads owned by Ratnapura Pradeshiya Sabha, in accordance with the work assigned to the Pradeshiya Sabhas of the Sabaragamuwa Province by the Series of Orders for the Permanent markings and delimiting as the roads and narrow roads maintained by the Pradeshiya Sabhas of the Sabaragamuwa Province that published in the Extraordinary Gazette No. 2316/20 dated 24th January 2023 under Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987 by the Governor of the Sabaragamuwa Province.

It is hereby further announced to file a case in a competent court before expiring a period of 3 months from the date of this notification to prove his/her right, if the party claiming the said land is of the opinion that any road or narrow road included in the said Schedule, is included in any land or part of land belongs to the claimant party.

It is further announced that every road or narrow road included in the said Schedule, where no such case has been filed before the expiry of 03 months period, will be marked as a road or narrow road owned by the Ratnapura Pradeshiya Sabha.
At the Office of the Ratnapura Pradeshiya Sabha,17th December, 2025.
H.L.N. Munasinghe, Chairman, Ratnapura Pradeshiya Sabha.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
